import threading,time
import psycopg
from test_review import accepted,observe,counters,effects

def test_real_owned_downstream_lock_has_deadline(a2,monkeypatch):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id
 connected=threading.Event();record={};result=[]
 original=a2.downstream._connect
 def connect():
  c=original();record['pid']=c.info.backend_pid
  record['timeouts']=c.execute("SELECT current_setting('statement_timeout'),current_setting('lock_timeout')").fetchone()
  connected.set();return c
 monkeypatch.setattr(a2.downstream,'_connect',connect)
 blocker=psycopg.connect(a2.downstream_dsn)
 blocker.execute('LOCK TABLE ds_operations IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE')
 def run():result.append(a2.service.run_operation(op))
 t=threading.Thread(target=run)
 try:
  t.start();assert connected.wait(10)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10;waiting=None
  with psycopg.connect(a2.downstream_dsn,autocommit=True) as controller:
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    waiting=controller.execute('SELECT wait_event_type,wait_event FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=%s',(record['pid'],)).fetchone()
    if waiting and waiting[0]=='Lock':break
    time.sleep(.02)
   assert waiting and waiting[0]=='Lock'
   started=time.monotonic(); t.join(7); assert not t.is_alive(), 'SQL wait failed to end automatically'; record['elapsed_after_lock_observed']=time.monotonic()-started
 finally:
  blocker.rollback();blocker.close();t.join(15)
 assert not t.is_alive() and len(result)==1 and result[0].status=='UNKNOWN'
 state={'observed_lock_wait':waiting,'statement_timeout':record['timeouts'][0],'lock_timeout':record['timeouts'][1],'cancelled_owned_backend':False,'elapsed':record['elapsed_after_lock_observed'],'status':result[0].status,'counters':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2)}
 observe('actual-downstream-lock',state)
 assert record['timeouts'][0]!='0' and record['timeouts'][1]!='0'
